headline: Paraguay's President removed following Ueno Bank collapse
summary: Paraguay's President Santiago Peña was removed from office via impeachment after being found guilty of poor performance linked to the collapse of digital lender Ueno Bank. Pedro Alliana has been sworn in as his successor.
why: The collapse of Ueno Bank, which cost up to 13% of GDP in historical context, has triggered a significant political crisis in Paraguay.

impacts.name: Paraguay
impacts.why: Political instability and bank failures typically lead to currency depreciation and capital flight.
